back.bm: Hidrostatik (cacing tanah), rangka luar (serangga, ketam), rangka dalam (vertebrata)

back.en: Moulting the exoskeleton so an arthropod can grow
back.bm: Penyalinan rangka luar supaya artropod boleh membesar

back.en: Axial: skull, vertebral column, ribs, sternum. Appendicular: limbs, pectoral and pelvic girdles
back.bm: Paksi: tengkorak, turus vertebra, rusuk, sternum. Apendikular: anggota, lengkungan pektoral dan pelvis

back.en: Support, protection, movement, blood cell production, mineral storage
back.bm: Sokongan, perlindungan, pergerakan, penghasilan sel darah, simpanan mineral

back.en: Tendon: muscle to bone, inelastic. Ligament: bone to bone, elastic
back.bm: Tendon: otot ke tulang, tidak kenyal. Ligamen: tulang ke tulang, kenyal

back.en: Cartilage (absorbs shock), synovial membrane, synovial fluid (lubricant), ligaments
back.bm: Rawan (serap hentakan), membran sinovia, bendalir sinovia (pelincir), ligamen

back.en: Skeletal (voluntary), smooth (gut walls, involuntary), cardiac (heart, never tires)
back.bm: Rangka (terkawal), licin (dinding salur, luar kawal), kardium (jantung, tidak lesu)

back.en: Pairs with opposite actions; one contracts, the other relaxes (biceps/triceps)
back.bm: Pasangan dengan tindakan bertentangan; satu mengecut, satu mengendur (biseps/triseps)

back.en: Myotome muscles contract alternately → S-shaped body waves; fins for balance and steering
back.bm: Otot miotom mengecut berselang-seli → gelombang badan berbentuk S; sirip untuk keseimbangan dan arah

back.en: Osteoporosis, osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, scoliosis, muscle cramp, sprain
back.bm: Osteoporosis, osteoartritis, artritis reumatoid, skoliosis, kejang otot, terseliuh

back.en: Calcium, vitamin D (sunlight), weight-bearing exercise, good posture, no smoking
back.bm: Kalsium, vitamin D (cahaya matahari), senaman menampung berat, postur baik, tidak merokok

back.en: Hydrostatic skeleton: circular and longitudinal muscles squeeze fluid-filled segments; chaetae grip the soil
back.bm: Rangka hidrostatik: otot membulat dan otot memanjang menekan segmen berisi bendalir; seta mencengkam tanah

back.en: Smooth, flexible tissue at the ends of bones in joints that reduces friction and absorbs shock
back.bm: Tisu licin dan fleksibel di hujung tulang pada sendi yang mengurangkan geseran dan menyerap hentakan

back.en: Hinge: moves in one plane (elbow, knee). Ball-and-socket: moves in all directions (shoulder, hip)
back.bm: Engsel: bergerak dalam satu satah (siku, lutut). Lesung: bergerak ke semua arah (bahu, pinggul)

front.en: How the arm bends and straightens

back.en: Bend: biceps contracts, triceps relaxes. Straighten: triceps contracts, biceps relaxes
back.bm: Bengkok: biseps mengecut, triseps mengendur. Lurus: triseps mengecut, biseps mengendur

tip.en: Muscles can only pull, never push — so they work in pairs.
tip.bm: Otot hanya boleh menarik, bukan menolak — jadi ia bekerja secara berpasangan.
